title: Changed UTF-8 blobs can produce zero scanned bytes
detail: Configured size threshold, global -diff attribute, old NUL blob, and old UTF-16 blob each produced a binary/no-hunk diff. Direct scan, real commit and real push all returned 0; the remote contained the listed literal.
fix: In added_bytes, preserve the unchanged-oid empty result, but scan the full new blob when differing blob oids produce no hunks. Add real commit/push tests for threshold, global attribute and binary-to-text transitions.

title: Listed identifiers in paths pass refuse mode
detail: A new private-slug folder, a private-slug basename and a pure rename into the folder all committed and pushed with exit 0. Content was clean. changes() also drops R100 renames because the blob oid is unchanged.
fix: Scan raw path bytes as well as content; retain non-deleted same-oid rename entries for path checking, while added_bytes returns empty on equal oids before gzip/binary handling. Test folder, basename, R100 rename and existing archive-rename compatibility.
